decks.summary: Taboo-compliant standard Tony who hunts bounty targets with his .38 Long Colts, Derringers and Knuckleduster, reloads with Contraband, and gains actions from Leo De Luca and Swift Reflexes.

Miracle-Rogue Tony who takes six or seven Switchblade (2) attacks a turn through Haste, Leo De Luca, Garrote Wire and his bounty action, boosted by Lonnie Ritter, Delilah and Hard Knocks; built for Expert.
Bewitching Tony who holds Ace in the Hole for twelve-action turns with Haste, Honed Instinct and Leo De Luca, oversucceeding with Switchblade (2) for damage and taking clues with Working a Hunch.
Fight-event Tony who spends his free bounty attack on Clean Them Out, Monster Slayer, One-Two Punch and Coup de Grâce, pulling enemies in with "Get over here!" and boosting with Lonnie Ritter.
Big-money Tony who stacks Embezzled Treasure, Lone Wolf and Pay Day into Well Connected, shops the Underworld Market, and shoots with Derringers and a Lupara using Chuck Fergus's extra actions.
Expert dedicated fighter Tony with .45 Thompsons, Derringers and his Long Colts, Lonnie Ritter and Leather Jacket for his low sanity, and Live and Learn and Lucky! to land shots.
Flex Tony who shoots with Thompsons and his Long Colts while building Lone Wolf and Dario El-Amin money into Well Connected and testless clues from Intel Report and Working a Hunch.
Primary-killer Tony for a Circle Undone Ironman run: Switchblade, Mauser and fight events like One-Two Punch and Counterpunch, plus Followed and Intel Report for the split-up scenarios.
Gatling Gun Tony dealing up to 36 damage a turn with Haste, Leo De Luca and his bounty action, reloading with Contraband and Extra Ammunition and protecting shots with Custom Modifications.
Seeker-splash Tony for three or four players: Switchblade (2) and Garrote Wire with Haste, a deep draw engine from Preposterous Sketches and Deep Knowledge, and Black Market to support the team.
